A Pinghu Watermelon

A PINGHU WATERMELON

Exhibition / LUZHAI, Nanhetou, Pinghu

From local culture
to a contemporary exhibition.

A single watermelon leads visitors through Pinghu’s local memories, stories of its varieties, and visions of its future. At LUZHAI, eight themed sections bring together text, images, characters, installations, and spatial storytelling.

Project type
Cultural exhibition
Venue
LUZHAI, Nanhetou, Pinghu
Themed sections
8
Read the original exhibition article ↗

Eight themes along one exhibition route.

Follow the watermelon from its biography and varieties through expressions, high summer, and travel, all the way to the future of seeds.

  1. The Watermelon’s Biography
  2. Measuring Sweetness
  3. As You Sow, So Shall You Reap
  4. Watermelon Stickers
  5. Plush Days of Summer
  6. The Watermelon’s Travels
  7. Tutai Watermelon Cart
  8. Seed Chip

Local culture, characters, and space.

Watermelon characters, local history, and travel props unfold between metal structures and timber galleries.

Seeds and imagined futures.

Exhibition map.

Eight exhibition areas follow the layout of LUZHAI. Two groups of themes form a continuous route through the venue.

case-shanhai-ip.html.html:
怪奇疗愈所
山海经 IP

Mythical creatures / Character system

角色研究 · 形象设计 · 表情与衍生

从原稿开始。

把《山海经》里的异兽，放进当代城市。“怪奇疗愈所”围绕五种情绪建立角色关系，从手绘线稿、彩色三视图，延展到表情动作、毛绒形态与日常用品。

藏在城市背面的疗愈所。

地铁晚高峰、周日晚的房间、加班后的走廊。世界观里的疗愈所隐藏在城市缝隙中，五位异兽在来访者疲惫的时候出现。

角色从各自的神话形态中提取识别特征，再赋予当代的陪伴方式：缓冲焦虑、释放标签、建立边界、恢复希望、拉宽时间。圆润的身体、柔软的毛发和短小四肢，连接起这组角色。

五个角色，五种陪伴。

五位角色的介绍、行为方式与造型细节，来自各自的设计方案。点击角色可直接跳转到介绍。

腓腓帝江猼訑乘黄当康

腓腓 Feifei

缓冲焦虑 / 你的情绪，在我这慢慢降落。

都市“情绪清零”

角色介绍

腓腓的灵感来自《山海经》“养之可以已忧”：陪伴即可消解忧虑。在都市版本中，它不再是山中的神兽，而是出现在情绪过载瞬间的存在，成为都市人的“情绪清零按钮”。

地铁晚高峰、周日晚的房间、工作崩溃的间隙，都是腓腓出现的地方。它的行为逻辑是“不干预、不判断、只吸收”。它不会说话，也不会给答案，只是静静待着，把你的焦虑一点点“吸走”。

蓬松的云状轮廓、半困的眼睛和包裹身体的大尾巴，构成一个可以靠近的安全区。前爪的黄色“X”贴布像创可贴，隐喻它自己也受过伤，却仍可以陪你一起修复。

造型细节

  • 不规则毛发形成云状轮廓，让轻微焦虑与情绪波动直接显现在外形上。
  • 黄红渐变的大眼睛呈现温暖、困倦、无害的状态；文化纹样面罩弱化嘴部表达，增加守护感。
  • 超大尾巴包裹身体，建立安全区；黄色“X”贴布与紫色小爪保留修复隐喻和异兽细节。
查看腓腓原始线稿 +

帝江 Dijiang

释放标签 / 不被定义，只寻开心。

都市“释放快乐球”

角色介绍

帝江的灵感来自《山海经》“无面目，却是识歌舞”：不需要面孔，也能自在存在。在都市版本中，它是“标签关闭”的存在，也是“释放快乐球”，让快乐不再依赖被看见、被评价。

镜头对着你的那一刻、必须开口介绍自己的场合、被比较和被审视的时候，帝江会静静出现。它的行为逻辑是“不解释、不表演、只存在”。它不会问你是谁，也不会要求你成为什么。

没有面孔的毛茸茸身体，刻意减少身份和情绪反馈。你可以在它身边放下标签，从“被看见”里退出来：不用解释，不用表现，甚至不用成为任何人；不需要被看清，才可以存在。

造型细节

  • 圆形毛茸茸身体没有明显头身分界，四个耳角融合的突起打破纯圆轮廓，保留混沌异兽感。
  • 面部删除眼、鼻、嘴，或只保留极简闭眼线，将“无面目”转化为去标签、去识别的视觉语言。
  • 高饱和黄色与深蓝色不规则环状、半环和块状斑纹形成快乐混沌，白色腹部提供视觉缓冲。
查看帝江原始线稿 +

猼訑 Boyi

建立边界 / 不用回头，一切都在被看见。

社交防御补给员

角色介绍

猼訑的灵感来自《山海经》“其目在背，佩之不畏”：看见背后，便不再畏惧。在都市版本中，它是社交边界的具象化，出现在“被观察感”过载的瞬间，为过度连接中的人守住背后。

拥挤的开放式办公区、必须应付的社交场合、被人议论却无法确认的时刻，都是猼訑的登场场景。它的行为逻辑是“不迎合、不解释、不对抗”，不会替你回应，也不会替你解释。

它只是静静待在你身后，把那些看不见的目光一点点“挡住”。正面被遮挡、背部大眼负责感知，环绕绑带形成包裹结构。视觉上的包裹意味着建立自我边界，提供“社交防御补给”。

造型细节

  • 粉色短毛绒、下垂耳与钝化羊角降低警觉和攻击感，保留温顺与防御的反差。
  • 正面眼部被遮挡，背部中央大眼形成“前封闭，后感知”的逻辑，承担反向观察和防御识别。
  • 交叉织带、扣件和自然垂落的带尾构成包裹结构，将自我边界表达为可以看见的机能符号。
查看猼訑原始线稿 +

乘黄 Chenghuang

拉宽时间 / 人生不是任务。

年龄危机的“时间扩张者”

角色介绍

乘黄的灵感来自《山海经》“乘之寿二千岁”：乘之，可见更长的时间。在都市版本中，它不再是传说中的长寿神兽，而是出现在“人生进度焦虑”里的存在，让时间变宽，拉长人生的尺度。

凌晨两点的招聘软件、三十岁前的人生清单、不断被比较的“成功时间表”，都是乘黄出现的时刻。它不催促、不比较、不定义阶段，只放慢时间感，稀释年龄焦虑。

它不会告诉你“来得及”，也不会替你做决定，只是静静趴在时间的缝隙里，让你意识到：人生不是倒计时，而是一条还很长的路。奶油色狐形、闭眼与云团般的大尾巴，共同呈现安静而缓慢的陪伴。

造型细节

  • 奶油色狐形与低重心的连续弧线形成缓慢漂浮感；耳尖和尾端的淡粉渐变表现时间流动。
  • 巨型尾巴占据约七成视觉比例，像包裹身体的时间缓冲层；默认闭眼，减少外界评价感。
  • 额头菱形如时间刻印，披肩以几何符号与环形图腾组合，把山海经式纹样转成现代文化识别。
查看乘黄原始线稿 +

当康 Dangkang

恢复希望 / 努力努力，幸运幸运。

非常非常努力的 INFJ

角色介绍

当康的灵感来自《山海经》“见则天下大穰”：当它出现，丰收就快来了。在都市版本中，它是“非常非常努力的 INFJ”，出现在努力感快要耗尽的瞬间，也是职业倦怠者的努力回报补给员。

周一早晨的办公桌边、写满待办事项的便签纸旁、加班到怀疑意义的深夜，以及付出很多却迟迟看不到回报的时候，当康会慢慢待在你旁边，把那些还没被看见的努力一点点“存起来”。

它不会催你更努力，也不会给你打鸡血。它相信，不是所有回报都会立刻发生，但认真做过的事不会凭空消失。青色小猪像刚学会飞的希望，是打工人身边最小只的好运预告：努力努力，幸运幸运。

造型细节

  • 低饱和青绿色与不规则白色毛斑表达希望、生长和未兑现的结果；大鼻子保留笨拙真实的亲和感。
  • 耳机式耳朵作为希望信号的接收器，小型飞行结构呈现“刚学会飞”的轻微悬浮和上升感。
  • 环绕身体的宽背带表现现实负重；短而蓬松的尾巴随静止和飞行变化，延伸尚未完成的能量。
查看当康原始线稿 +

让性格变成表情与动作。

从困倦、开心到受惊、放空，同一角色在不同状态下保持轮廓与符号的连续性。表情动作让角色进入聊天、贴纸和日常叙事。

从角色，走向可以触摸的陪伴。

围绕毛绒挂件、手机配件、包袋和家居用品展开应用探索。角色的轮廓、纹样和色彩，在不同尺度与触感中继续保持识别。

回到城市里。

把五个角色的陪伴语言放入街道、交通和公共空间的想象中。短句与放大的角色形象共同形成系列传播。

一套逐步生长的角色系统。

角色研究先确定外形、位置、能力与出现的场景，再用手绘原稿建立三视图。色彩、面部遮挡、纹样、尾巴与耳部结构，为每个角色留下清晰的记忆点。

以上整理自项目原稿与桌面设计资料：0330 总览、0509 方案、0607 五位角色方案及彩色三视图。表情、衍生与传播展示沿用已有设计，其中应用场景为概念效果图。

case-shanhai-ip.html.html_en:
The Curious Healing Clinic
Classic of Mountains and Seas IP

Mythical creatures / Character system

Character research · Character design · Expressions and product concepts

Starting with the original drawings.

The Curious Healing Clinic brings mythical creatures from the Classic of Mountains and Seas into a contemporary city. Five emotional needs shape their roles, from hand-drawn sketches and color turnarounds to expressions, poses, plush forms, and everyday objects.

A clinic hidden in the city.

Rush hour on the subway, a room on Sunday night, a hallway after overtime. The clinic lives in the gaps of city life, where five mythical creatures appear when visitors are worn out.

Each character retains recognizable features from its mythological form and offers a different kind of companionship: easing anxiety, shedding labels, setting boundaries, restoring hope, or making time feel more spacious. Rounded bodies, soft fur, and short limbs tie the group together.

Five characters, five kinds of companionship.

The profiles, behavior, and visual details come from the individual designs. Select a character to jump to its profile.

FeifeiDijiangBoyiChenghuangDangkang

Feifei Feifei

Easing anxiety / Let your feelings settle here.

An emotional reset for city life

Character profile

The Classic of Mountains and Seas says that keeping a Feifei can ease worry. In the city, Feifei appears when feelings become overwhelming, offering an emotional reset.

Feifei turns up on crowded evening trains, in quiet rooms on Sunday nights, and when work becomes too much. It quietly absorbs anxiety, giving you space to feel it without judgment or intervention.

A fluffy cloud silhouette, sleepy eyes, and a huge tail wrapped around the body make Feifei feel safe to approach. The yellow X patch on its front paw looks like a bandage, suggesting that it knows what it means to be hurt and can keep you company as you heal.

Design details

  • Uneven tufts form a cloudlike silhouette that gives visible shape to mild anxiety and shifting moods.
  • Large eyes shaded from yellow to red look warm, sleepy, and harmless. A mask with traditional motifs softens the mouth’s expression and lends a protective quality.
  • An oversized tail wraps around the body to create a safe space. The yellow X patch suggests healing, while the small purple paws recall Feifei’s mythical origins.
View Feifei’s original line art +

Dijiang Dijiang

Shedding labels / Find joy on your own terms.

A ball of joy for city life

Character profile

In the Classic of Mountains and Seas, Dijiang has no face yet understands song and dance. Its urban counterpart lets people set aside labels and find joy free from the pressure of being seen or judged.

Dijiang appears when a camera turns toward you, when you have to introduce yourself, or when others are comparing and scrutinizing you. It quietly shares the moment and leaves you free to be whoever you are.

Its faceless, furry body offers few clues to identity or emotion. In its company you can set down your labels, step out of the spotlight, and feel at ease simply being there.

Design details

  • Four protrusions that blend ears and horns interrupt the round, furry silhouette. The head and body flow together, recalling the creature’s mythic shapelessness.
  • The face is blank or reduced to a simple line for closed eyes, turning the mythic absence of a face into a visual language that leaves identity open.
  • Vivid yellow and deep blue rings, half-rings, and patches create a sense of playful chaos. A white belly gives the eye a place to rest.
View Dijiang’s original line art +

Boyi Boyi

Setting boundaries / I’ll keep watch behind you.

A guardian of social boundaries

Character profile

In the Classic of Mountains and Seas, Boyi has eyes on its back, and wearing its hide dispels fear. In the city, Boyi embodies social boundaries, watching your back when the feeling of being observed becomes overwhelming.

Boyi appears in crowded open-plan offices, at obligatory social events, and when you suspect people are talking about you. It stays nearby, leaving you free to respond in your own way.

Boyi quietly stays behind you, shielding you from unseen scrutiny. The front is covered, a large eye on the back senses what is nearby, and straps wrap around the body. The wrapping makes personal boundaries visible and offers a sense of social protection.

Design details

  • Short pink fur, drooping ears, and rounded ram horns soften the silhouette, balancing gentleness with a protective role.
  • The front eyes are covered. A large central eye on the back watches in the opposite direction and detects potential threats.
  • Crossed webbing, buckles, and loose strap ends wrap the body, giving personal boundaries a visible, functional form.
View Boyi’s original line art +

Chenghuang Chenghuang

Making time feel wider / Live at your own pace.

A companion for anxiety about getting older

Character profile

The Classic of Mountains and Seas says that riding Chenghuang grants two thousand years of life. In the city, it appears when people worry about falling behind, slowing their sense of time and giving life a longer horizon.

Chenghuang appears as you scroll job listings at two in the morning, revisit your list of goals before thirty, or compare yourself to somebody else’s timeline. It lets the moment slow down and eases the pressure of age and milestones.

It rests quietly in the gaps of time, leaving you to make your own choices and reminding you how much road still lies ahead. A cream-colored fox shape, closed eyes, and an oversized cloudlike tail give it a quiet, unhurried presence.

Design details

  • Low, continuous curves give the cream-colored fox a slow, floating quality. Pale pink gradients at the ears and tail suggest the passage of time.
  • The huge tail makes up about seventy percent of the silhouette and wraps around the body like a buffer against time. Closed eyes soften the feeling of being judged.
  • A diamond on the forehead resembles a mark of time. The cape combines geometric symbols and circular motifs, giving patterns inspired by the Classic of Mountains and Seas a contemporary form.
View Chenghuang’s original line art +

Dangkang Dangkang

Restoring hope / A little effort, a little luck.

A very, very hardworking INFJ

Character profile

In the Classic of Mountains and Seas, the sight of Dangkang foretells an abundant harvest. This hardworking urban INFJ appears when your energy is nearly spent, keeping burned-out workers company while their efforts have yet to pay off.

Dangkang sits beside you at your desk on Monday morning, by sticky notes filled with tasks, and late at night when overtime starts to feel pointless. It quietly saves up the work that has yet to be recognized.

Dangkang keeps you company without pushing or cheering you on. It believes that careful work lasts even when the rewards take time. This little teal pig, barely able to fly, brings workers a small promise of good luck.

Design details

  • Muted teal and irregular white patches suggest hope, growth, and results yet to come. A large snout gives Dangkang an endearingly awkward expression.
  • Headphone-like ears pick up signals of hope. Small flight components make Dangkang hover and rise as though it has just learned to fly.
  • Wide harness straps suggest the weight of everyday life. The short, fluffy tail shifts between rest and flight, hinting at energy still in reserve.
View Dangkang’s original line art +

Expressing personality through faces and poses.

From drowsy and delighted to startled and blank, each character keeps its recognizable silhouette and motifs. Expressions and poses bring the characters into chats, stickers, and everyday stories.

Companionship you can hold.

The designs extend to plush charms, phone accessories, bags, and home goods. Silhouettes, patterns, and colors stay recognizable across materials and scales.

Back into the city.

These concepts bring the five characters and their messages into streets, transit, and public spaces. Short lines of copy pair with large-scale character images across the series.

How the character system took shape.

Research established each character’s appearance, role, abilities, and settings before hand-drawn sketches became three-view turnarounds. Color, facial coverings, patterns, tails, and ears give each character a distinct identity.

Based on the original drawings and design materials: the 0330 overview, the 0509 proposal, and the 0607 proposals and color turnarounds for all five characters. Expressions, merchandise, and campaign imagery use existing designs. Application scenes are concept renderings.

case-xuzhimo-haining.html.html:
从水中诗，到诗中潮—徐志摩在海宁
文化IP及展览 · 2025 · 嘉兴海宁
徐志摩从海宁走出。
故乡带给他诗歌最初的意向。康桥的柔波与江南的月影，海韵的猛进与钱塘潮的奔涌，水的两重印记刻入徐志摩的诗歌之中。
海宁也被徐志摩带向世界。
水不止温柔，也蕴藏着力量。新月诗派对格律的雕琢与对陈规的打破，是猛进如潮的海宁精神，在诗歌疆域里嘹亮的回响。
本次展览，我们将“水”作为理解徐志摩与海宁的线索。从“水中诗”，看见徐志摩的故乡旧影；
从“诗中潮”，读懂徐志摩的诗歌新潮。同时，还留有一处属于你的角落，在志摩故里为你写一首可以听的诗。
此水流入此间，与你交汇。
Location: 嘉兴海宁
Year: 2025

case-xuzhimo-haining.html.html_en:
Poems in Water, Tides in Verse: Xu Zhimo in Haining
Cultural IP and exhibition · 2025 · Haining, Jiaxing
Xu Zhimo set out from Haining.
His hometown gave his poetry its earliest imagery. The gentle ripples of Cambridge and the moon reflected in Jiangnan, the surge of his poem “The Sound of the Sea” and the rush of the Qiantang tidal bore: both faces of water left their mark on his verse.
Through Xu Zhimo, Haining traveled out into the world.
Water holds power as well as tenderness. The Crescent Moon poets refined meter and broke with convention, carrying Haining’s tide-like momentum into modern poetry.
The exhibition follows water as a way to understand Xu Zhimo and Haining. “Poems in Water” looks back at the hometown he knew.
“Tides in Verse” traces the new currents in his poetry. There is also a place of your own in Xu’s hometown, where a poem can be written for you to hear.
The water flows into this space and meets you here.

如何在当下筑造自己的“境界”？
生于潮水的海宁，终将以潮水的语言作答。

case-wangguowei.html.html_en:
Old Papers, New Verses: Wang Guowei in Haining
Cultural IP and exhibition · 2025 · Haining, Jiaxing
For the inaugural exhibition at here Art Museum, we looked for a new way to understand Wang Guowei, a scholar, critic, and poet who lived between tradition and modernity and between China and the West. The exhibition begins on the ground beneath your feet in Haining, tracing the quiet connections between Wang and his hometown.

“Last night I found old papers in a book. This morning I turned them into new verses.” Wang Guowei’s lines open the exhibition. The old papers evoke yellowed letters and manuscripts, the path of study he walked along Yanguan’s stone streets, and the question of poetic realms he refined in Remarks on Ci Poetry. The new verses are our reflections on the pursuit of ideals and a reply across time. As Wang’s aesthetic ideals take the form of the rising and falling Qiantang tide, we ask:
How can we build a realm of our own today?
Haining, born of the tide, will answer in its language.

《亲密人机 · A Heart In ThinkPad》

- Chapter 1 - 进化美学

自诞生以来，ThinkPad以标志性的小红点、沉静的黑色机身和极简的工业设计，铸就独树一帜的产品美学——不随潮流，却引领时代。每一代的产品革新都是对工程与技术的极致追求，更是对科技进化之美的独特诠释。以思考更新思考，让创新成为超越时空的品牌印记。

- Chapter 2 - 新身临其境

作为连接AI的新桥梁，ThinkPad不断突破传统人机互动的边界，融入前沿互动技术，让创造力尽情释放，带来丰富而真实的感官体验，唤醒人类与科技共创的艺术潜能。在数字与现实交织的世界中，ThinkPad引领用户探索多层次的生活可能性，激发全新的沉浸体验。

- Chapter 3 - 机器同理心

AI不应只是冰冷的计算工具，而是能够感知人类情感、理解场景需求的伙伴。ThinkPad在各个专业领域中深入探索无论是医生利用智能设备精准诊疗，还是电子机器狗带来的陪伴与温暖，ThinkPad致力于融入真实应用场景，赋予AI真正的温度与关怀，成为用户最贴心的支持者。

- Chapter 4 - 人机共生

从思考力工具到智能伙伴，ThinkPad不仅是你的“PC”，更是你的“CP”，助力每一个体在通往星辰大海的伟大旅程中绽放潜力。以创新精神引领人机共生的新篇章，ThinkPad赋能人类与机器的协同进化，携手开创属于人机文明共同体的未来。

A Heart in ThinkPad
Cultural IP and exhibition · 2024 · Beijing 798

A Heart in ThinkPad

- Chapter 1 - The Aesthetics of Evolution

ThinkPad established its visual identity with a signature red TrackPoint, a black chassis, and a pared-back industrial design. Each generation refines its engineering and expresses the beauty of technological evolution. Rethinking familiar ideas has made innovation a lasting part of the brand.

- Chapter 2 - New Immersive Experiences

As a bridge to AI, ThinkPad expands human-computer interaction with technologies that make creative work tangible and bring people and machines together in rich sensory experiences. Where the digital and physical meet, visitors can explore new ways to create and live.

- Chapter 3 - Machine Empathy

AI can recognize human emotions and respond to the needs of a situation. From smart devices that help doctors make precise diagnoses to robotic dogs that offer companionship, ThinkPad explores practical ways for AI to support people with care.

- Chapter 4 - Human-Machine Symbiosis

ThinkPad has evolved from a tool for thought into an intelligent companion, a PC that can also be a creative partner. The exhibition looks toward a future in which people and machines evolve together and help each other reach further.

Business Introduction

一、公司介绍

0086.AI是一家致力于定义“AI+”商业新范式的原生 AI 科技企业。我们正在重塑传统企业服务的交付逻辑——拒绝兜售仅供操作的软件工具，而是通过前沿的 AI Agent（智能体）技术，为您交付可直接落地、具备执行力的业务结果。

我们的核心优势在于构建一支由 AI 驱动的“全能数字专家团”。从顶层的商业战略梳理，到前端的智能建站与全球化营销，再到后端的海外获客、产品设计与内部人才赋能，我们将先进的 AI 能力无缝融入企业经营的关键环节。

凭借一支兼具全球化技术视野与深厚落地经验的专家团队，我们致力于帮助每一家企业构建专属的 AI 数字化核心竞争力，在人工智能时代实现运营效率的指数级跃升与商业模式的敏捷重塑。

使命 (Mission) - What we do

将前沿 AI 能力转化为核心生产力，通过深度整合业务流，驱动企业商业价值的持续跃升。

愿景 (Vision) - Where we go

让每家企业都能拥有自己的 AI “超级员工”，成为企业在 AI 时代最值得信赖的共生伙伴。

核心价值观 (Core Values)

  • 创新 (Innovation) - 以终为始：拒绝盲目的技术堆砌。我们坚持以终为始，用最前沿的 AI 技术，解决最棘手的商业挑战，确保每一次创新都能转化为客户的竞争优势。
  • 敏捷 (Agility) - 拥抱变化：在不确定性中寻找确定性。我们保持极度敏锐的市场嗅觉与技术快速迭代的执行力，以初创者的速度，响应瞬息万变的业务需求。
  • 信赖 (Trust) - 坚守底线：数据安全是我们的生命线。我们深知商业秘密是企业的核心命脉，严守数据伦理与合规边界，是我们对客户不可逾越的承诺。
  • 共生 (Partnership) - 互相成就：客户的成功是我们存在的唯一理由。我们不只交付项目，更致力于成为企业长期的外部智囊与战略技术合伙人，在 AI 浪潮中共同进化。

二、产品与服务体系 (Products & Services)

核心架构：1 + 6 全链路智能赋能

我们要构建的不是一套软件，而是一个能进化的企业 AI 生命体。我们以“核心智脑（AI 知识库）”为资产地基，驱动六大“超级员工”深入业务前线，为企业构建从战略决策到市场变现的完整闭环。

Phase 1: 核心地基 (The Foundation)

服务前提：在部署任何 Agent 之前，我们首先协助企业完成核心数据的私有化沉淀。

核心智脑 - 基于 RAG 技术的企业级专属 AI 知识库

定义：不仅仅是存储文档的云盘，而是企业的“数字大脑”。它是所有上层 AI Agent 的智慧源头，确保每一次 AI 的产出都精准符合企业的品牌调性与业务逻辑。

核心价值：沉淀专属数字资产

服务内容：我们提供“全量混合采集”服务。不仅通过技术清洗产品手册、历史合同等显性文档，更通过深度访谈挖掘创始人与业务专家的隐性经验（直觉、判例、方法论），将散落在人脑中的智慧转化为可永久传承、可被 AI 调用的结构化资产。

Phase 2: 六大核心引擎 (The 6 Core Agents)

Business Introduction

Company overview

0086.AI is an AI-native technology company building a new model for applying AI to business. We use AI agents to deliver outcomes that clients can put to work directly, changing how enterprise services are delivered.

We build teams of versatile AI specialists. Their work spans business strategy, intelligent website development, global marketing, international lead generation, product design, and employee development.

Our team combines a global view of technology with hands-on implementation experience. We help each company build AI capabilities around its own operations so it can improve efficiency and adapt its business model as conditions change.

Mission

Turn advances in AI into practical capabilities that fit into business workflows and create lasting value.

Vision

Give every company its own AI super-employees and become a trusted partner as it grows with AI.

Core values

  • Innovation · Start with the outcome — We start with the business challenge and apply AI where it can solve it and give the client a competitive advantage.
  • Agility · Embrace change — We stay close to the market, iterate quickly, and respond to changing business needs at startup speed.
  • Trust · Safeguard client data — Business secrets are central to a company’s operations. We protect client data and uphold our commitments to data ethics and compliance.
  • Partnership · Grow together — Our work is measured by our clients’ success. We aim to serve as a long-term adviser and technology partner as their use of AI evolves.

Products and services

Core architecture: one knowledge base and six agents

A private AI knowledge base supports six agents across business operations, from strategic decisions to bringing products and services to market. The system develops alongside the company.

Phase 1: The foundation

Before deployment — We first help the company collect and organize its core data in a private environment.

Enterprise AI knowledge base powered by retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

Purpose: The knowledge base gives every agent a shared source of company knowledge so its output reflects the brand’s voice and how the business operates.

Value: Build a proprietary digital asset.

Service: We clean and organize documents such as product manuals and historical contracts. Through in-depth interviews, we capture founders’ and specialists’ judgment, precedents, and methods as structured knowledge that the company can preserve and its agents can use.

Phase 2: The six core agents

  • Strategy Compass: Brand strategy agent — An AI strategy partner that turns business intuition and early ideas into a clear strategy.
  • Digital Storefront: Full-stack website agent — Build an international website through natural-language interaction, then deploy and maintain it with one click.
  • Traffic Engine: Marketing content agent — Produce brand-aligned content at scale, tailored to global social platforms and designed to convert.
  • Team Development: Internal training content agent — Generate training materials from real business cases and help employees learn from high-performing colleagues.
  • Global Outreach: International prospecting agent — Search global data for high-value leads and help export teams target the right customers.
  • Innovation Accelerator: Design assistance agent — Speed up R&D with product concept visuals and refine marketing materials.

Why choose 0086.AI

Consulting and technology

Approach — Map the business workflow before deploying AI.

Value — We use a consulting approach to identify operational problems, then turn broad needs into technical specifications that fit the way the company works.

Ready to use

Approach — We handle the technical complexity so the service is easy to use.

Value — Give agents expert-level tasks in everyday language, as you would in a chat. Employees can start using them without training.

Ongoing iteration and tuning

Approach — We work with clients after launch as their needs change.

Value — We build the knowledge base and continue tuning models and refining strategies so agents keep delivering value as the business grows.

A global view of technology

Approach — We track developments worldwide and respond as they happen.

Value — We monitor AI advances globally, including in Silicon Valley, and quickly incorporate relevant improvements into your products so they keep pace with the field.
